registryBasis: Official Nagaon district revenue services identify Assam ILRMS implementation in all seven historical Nagaon circles and provide land-record/trace-map services; the current Assam ILRMS public viewer exposes Nagaon district selection. This evidences a local/state land-record custodian, not an open citywide parcel geometry API.

officialSources.observation: Nagaon district government page describes ILRMS implementation in Nagaon and citizen land-record services including Jamabandi copies and land-holding trace maps. No parcel geometry endpoint is provided on the page.

Current public Dharitree page lists Nagaon in the district selector and loads a public location workflow. The page requires district/circle/village selection and does not expose a citywide vector layer in its initial HTML.
Government of India DILRMP page is explicitly scoped to Assam, District Nagaon and reports cadastral-map/digitization status fields. It is status metadata, not a parcel geometry service.
Assamese first-party guidance states that land records include Chitha, Jamabandi and maps. It documents records/procedure, not a public parcel vector response.

requests.outcome: bounded TLS-verified GET succeeded; HTML and current JavaScript asset were retrieved. The page exposed the public district selector and no parcel geometry/schema/CRS payload.

bounded TLS-verified GET succeeded; current JavaScript exposed POST routes Welcome/getCirdivJson, Welcome/getVillCodeJson and village search, plus form navigation toward ROR records. No map/GeoJSON endpoint was present in the inspected script.

HTTP 200 JSON response returned 8 Nagaon circles, including নগাওঁ with cir_code 01 01. Only safe administrative location codes/names were retained in ignored scratch evidence; no parcel or personal fields were requested.
HTTP 500 with empty response body; no village payload, parcel IDs, geometry, schema or CRS captured. This failure is not evidence of parcel absence or citywide absence.

bounded TLS-verified GET succeeded; public Jamabandi page and location.js were retrieved. It exposed administrative lookup/form routes and captcha-gated record display, but no parcel geometry response was obtained.
bounded request timed out; no portal configuration or service payload captured. Timeout is not evidence of absence.
